set.body: Reproduce repetitive_similarity with explicit phase and repetition relations, directed focal/reference roles, same-participant strata, self-edge policy, pairwise versus reduced results and realized denominators. Recheck the pinned eyesim join behavior with duplicate, unmatched and empty strata. Exit with an exhaustive independent pair oracle, finite-cap control case, public saved plan, tidy export and JVM/Scala.js guide tests.
set.title: Implement repetition and reinstatement as a public workflow
